summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a material event response to Peru's SMV regarding Holcim Ltd.'s acquisition of 99.99% of Inversiones ASPI S.A., which holds 50.01% of the Company's share capital. The response relays Holcim's comments on a minority shareholder's submission and details of purchase-price adjustments under the Share Purchase Agreement. The base purchase price was S/ 1,850,370,000. Holcim, now controlling shareholder, provided the requested information. What to watch: regulatory scrutiny and any impact on transaction finalization.
